bundle.shortDescription: Test whether your Bitcoin recovery plan actually works.
bundle.longDescription: Bitcoin Lifeboat is a free, open-source, local-first desktop app and CLI that helps Bitcoin self-custody users test whether their recovery plan works — without uploading secrets or risking real funds.
